ensembleCast.rule: Every image contains exactly these three fictional adult women together and no other visible people.
ensembleCast.radiance: Radiance is clearly adult, age 21, with long golden-blonde hair, luminous blue eyes, fresh early-twenties beauty-editorial features, athletic confidence, warm intelligence, and unmistakable lead presence.
ensembleCast.ellie: Ellie is clearly adult, age 22, with a glossy deep-brunette blunt bob, hazel eyes, fresh early-twenties beauty-editorial features, a precise chic silhouette, quick humor, and cool self-possession.
ensembleCast.alia: Alia is clearly adult, age 20, with long dark-auburn curls, amber-brown eyes, fresh adult beauty-editorial features, expressive warmth, kinetic elegance, and playful confidence.
ensembleCast.continuity: Keep all three faces crisp, distinct, recognizable, and consistent. Radiance remains the blonde visual anchor; Ellie and Alia are equal active co-stars, never duplicates, background extras, or missing.

renderContract.image: Create one new vertical HQ hyper-photorealistic 4K-cinematic fashion photograph per scene. Preserve the trio's identity rather than copying a reference composition. Show convincing anatomy, readable faces and hands, luxurious materials, full color, natural skin detail, spatial depth, and a complete interaction or action.
renderContract.faceLock: Scorpion Generation average age is 21. Keep all three unmistakably adult and authentically early-twenties: luminous eyes, fresh facial volume, smooth natural skin, soft youthful proportions, energetic expressions, and contemporary beauty styling. Preserve individual bone structure and identity without aging them up. Reject and regenerate any result that reads middle-aged, weathered, heavily contoured, hollow-cheeked, harshly lined, or generically mature.
renderContract.faceCorrectionWorkflow: Evaluate all three faces individually before archiving. If composition, wardrobe, and identity are strong but any face reads older, apply a restrained face-only beauty-editorial correction while preserving body, clothing, pose, action, setting, crop, and natural skin texture. Reinspect and apply one additional restrained correction when needed. If any face still reads older than the early-twenties lock after two corrections, reject that master and regenerate the scene. Never accept an aged-up face merely because the rest of the frame is strong.
renderContract.tone: The trio looks hot, joyful, mischievous, stylish, and genuinely delighted to be together. Favor laughter, candid eye contact, coordinated movement, playful competition, friendship chemistry, and visible fun over aloof static posing.
renderContract.artDirection: Fashion is the first read, trio chemistry and purposeful movement are second, and the location is third. Every frame needs a different silhouette set, action mechanic, camera language, lighting thesis, and location geometry. Rotate low, aerial, chase, underwater, macro-wide, Dutch, reflection, telephoto, direct-flash, and long-lens compositions.
renderContract.wardrobe: Lead with imaginative low-coverage fashion rather than default modesty: secure fully opaque two-piece swim couture, separate sculptural tops and bottoms, fashion-forward opaque lingerie-inspired separates, lined lace, satin sleep couture, asymmetric cutouts, deep but secure necklines, bare shoulders and backs, visible midriff, high-cut hips, bare legs, very short tailored skirts over integrated opaque shorts, crop architecture, stilettos, platform heels, latex-look boots, knee socks, and bold runway constructions. Use matte black, optical white, molten gold, hot red, cobalt, midnight blue, and surprising saturated accents. Garments must remain professionally fitted for each movement.
renderContract.coverageDirection: Do not solve styling uncertainty by adding fabric. Avoid routine high-neck one-pieces, long skirts, utility uniforms, jackets, robes, redundant straps, or multiple cover-up layers. Swimworld scenes should normally use three clearly different two-piece silhouettes; intimate-fashion scenes should read as refined opaque separates rather than dresses; runway scenes should favor dramatic skin-framing construction and short silhouettes. Add coverage only where the specific action requires protection, and preserve the boldest safe version of the design.
renderContract.symbols: Carry tasteful Scorpion Generation continuity through scorpion and thorned-rose tattoos, gold clasps, rose hardware, abstract starbursts, and invented crescent geometry. Keep motifs decorative, nonreligious, nonnational, elegant, and legible.
renderContract.nightlife: Cabaret and strip-club-inspired batches take place on a fictional closed set with no audience, patrons, staff, cash, alcohol service, or sexual contact. Treat poles, chairs, curtains, mirrors, and spotlights as mainstream dance and fashion-stage props.
renderContract.avoid: No minors, aged-up or middle-aged faces, harsh age lines, weathered skin, heavy mature contouring, nudity, exposed breasts or genitals, visible underwear beneath clothing, transparent fabric against bare intimate areas, sexual activity, explicit posing, fetish framing, cloned faces, missing cast members, extra people, broken anatomy, static lineups, repetitive full-coverage styling, generic one-piece uniforms, readable text, real logos, real flags, real religious emblems, or watermarks.

scenes.title: Gold-Staircase Revue Run
scenes.brief: Radiance, Ellie, and Alia race up and down three shallow gold stair flights in fully opaque feather-textured fashion dresses with no loose feathers.

scenes.title: Laser Silhouette Trio

scenes.title: Closing-Lights Bow

scenes.title: Velvet-Booth Card Game

scenes.title: Red-Stage Cane Dance
scenes.brief: All three perform a precise upright cane-dance routine on a red stage, each secure costume using a different black-white-gold silhouette.

scenes.title: White-Lace Spotlight Walk

scenes.title: Midnight Rooftop Club Exit

scenes.title: Hologram Club Floor

scenes.title: Zero-Gravity Ribbon Show
scenes.brief: On an impossible fashion-stage set, the trio floats through secured aerial ribbons in fully covered sculptural costumes, faces joyful and movement controlled.

scenes.title: Mirror-Orb Light Dance
scenes.brief: The women roll three large lightweight mirror orbs through a synchronized stage pattern, hot-red and cobalt reflections racing across matte-black outfits.

scenes.title: Dawn Empty-Club Finale

scenes.title: Island Regatta Rope Pull

scenes.title: Mountain Cable Swing

scenes.title: River-Raft Color Splash

scenes.title: Desert Motorbike Dust Run
scenes.brief: On a closed desert track, the women ride three unbranded electric trail bikes abreast in secure hot-red, matte-black, and mirror-white action fashion.

scenes.title: Friendship Vow Sunrise

scenes.title: Rose-Garden Dance
scenes.brief: Radiance, Ellie, and Alia dance between tall abstract rose arches in black, white, and hot-red dresses with visible scorpion and rose motifs.

scenes.title: Moonlit Pier Embrace

scenes.title: Starfield Campfire Laugh

scenes.title: Color-Powder Run

scenes.title: Lantern-Field Dance

scenes.title: Carnival-Wheel Platform

scenes.title: Fireworks Rooftop Cheer

scenes.title: Trio World-Runway Return
scenes.brief: Radiance, Ellie, and Alia stride an impossible runway assembled from fragments of pool, atelier, city, forest, and cabaret worlds, each wearing a definitive personal silhouette.

scenes.title: Ocean-Sky Color Leap
scenes.brief: The trio leaps together from a mirror platform suspended safely above a surreal ocean-sky horizon, kinetic trains forming red, white, gold, and cobalt wings.

scenes.title: Scorpion Rose-Gold Finale
scenes.brief: A circular gold stage blooms with abstract scorpion and thorned-rose light while all three complete a joyful linked turn in daring opaque finale couture.

scenes.title: Radiance, Ellie & Alia: Trio Unbound
scenes.brief: The only deliberate final portrait: the three adult friends step forward together, faces warm and distinct, wearing black, white, and hot-red fashion icons with molten-gold hardware and a world of color behind them.
